AAP.caption: Properties
AAP.doc: You can send properties with their values.
AAP.name: properties

AAR.caption: Send Custom Events _________________________________________________________
AAR.doc: send more context than the default event info that PostHog captures whenever a user does something. In that case, you can send an event with any properties you may wish to add.
AAR.name: info

AAl.caption: Properties JSON
AAl.doc: Optional. A JSON object as text, for example {"plan_count": 3, "is_trial": true}. Unlike the key/value list, JSON keeps numbers, booleans and lists typed. Merged over the Properties list; invalid JSON is ignored with a console warning.
AAl.name: properties_json
